# Source and license

Source repository: https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-FPS  
Author / publisher: Kenney  
Pinned upstream HEAD at research time: `185fd2326d74a5cf858cffc616f87cf9696f9cc0`  
Retrieved: 2026-09-07

This directory is a curated copy containing only engine-neutral assets from the upstream Starter Kit FPS.

Upstream licensing statement:

- starter-kit software/code: MIT License
- included 2D sprites, 3D models and sound effects: CC0

The upstream README and LICENSE files are preserved as `UPSTREAM-README.md` and `UPSTREAM-LICENSE.md`.

Only the following asset categories were copied here:

- `models/*.glb`
- `sounds/*.ogg`
- `sprites/*.png`

Godot-specific scenes, resources, scripts, import metadata, project configuration and the bundled font were intentionally excluded.
